content: 1. The risk of bias graph illustrates the review authors' assessments of the risk of bias for each item, presented as percentages across all included studies. 2. The risk of bias summary provides a detailed evaluation of the review authors' judgments regarding the risk of bias for each individual study included in the analysis. 3. A forest plot compares the use of convalescent plasma versus placebo or standard care in patients with moderate to severe COVID-19, specifically analyzing the outcome of 28-day mortality. 4. Another forest plot compares convalescent plasma to placebo or standard care in moderate to severe COVID-19 cases, focusing on the outcome of mechanical ventilation, whether non-invasive or invasive. 5. A forest plot evaluates the comparison of convalescent plasma versus placebo or standard care in moderate to severe COVID-19 cases, with the outcome being hospital admission. 6. The next forest plot compares convalescent plasma to placebo or standard care in moderate to severe COVID-19 cases, analyzing the outcome of patient discharge. 7. A forest plot examines the comparison of convalescent plasma versus placebo or standard care in moderate to severe COVID-19 cases, focusing on clinical improvement by day 28. 8. Another forest plot compares convalescent plasma to placebo or standard care in moderate to severe COVID-19 cases, with the outcome being admission to the intensive care unit (ICU). 9. A forest plot evaluates the comparison of convalescent plasma versus placebo or standard care in moderate to severe COVID-19 cases, specifically analyzing the occurrence of serious adverse events (SAEs). 10. A forest plot compares convalescent plasma to placebo or standard care in patients with mild COVID-19, focusing on the outcome of 28-day mortality. 11. Another forest plot evaluates the comparison of convalescent plasma versus placebo or standard care in mild COVID-19 cases, analyzing the outcome of mechanical ventilation, whether non-invasive or invasive. 12. A forest plot compares convalescent plasma to placebo or standard care in mild COVID-19 cases, with the outcome being hospital admission. 13. Another forest plot evaluates the comparison of convalescent plasma versus placebo or standard care in mild COVID-19 cases, focusing on admission to the intensive care unit (ICU). 14. A forest plot compares convalescent plasma to placebo or standard care in mild COVID-19 cases, specifically analyzing the occurrence of serious adverse events (SAEs).
